rules.name: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
rules.description: Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api1%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: API2: Broken Authentication — Default Credentials
rules.description: Detects API authentication attempts using default or well-known credentials
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api2%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: API3: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
rules.description: Detects API responses returning sensitive properties that the user should not access
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_003", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api3%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: API4: Unrestricted Resource Consumption — Rate Limiting
rules.description: Detects API requests exceeding rate limits indicating denial of service or scraping attacks
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_004", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: API5: Broken Function Level Authorization
rules.description: Detects access to administrative API endpoints by non-administrative users
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_005", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" IN ('UpdateApiKey', 'UploadApiKey', 'CreateApiKey', 'DeleteApiKey') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: API6: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows

rules.name: API7: Server-Side Request Forgery via API
